entries.title: PAL front cover
entries.use: Primary reference for tank mass, warm industrial metal, white wordmark and the Q emblem.
entries.limit: Spanish PAL print code 1000373.202.SP. Use as an archival cover, not a newly assembled UK case.
entries.credit: PSX Data Center; scanner not identified

entries.title: US front cover
entries.use: Compare the same central art with a different side rail and publisher band. Preserve the focal face and weapon.
entries.limit: NTSC U/C packaging. Scan color and wear differ from the PAL reference.

entries.title: English PAL back cover
entries.use: Reference for compact information hierarchy, screenshot grouping, descriptive copy and the physical spine.
entries.limit: UK code 1000373.201.UK. The included spines and legal marks belong to historical packaging.
entries.credit: VIDEO GAME COLLECTOR / PSX Data Center

entries.title: PAL disc label
entries.use: A restrained circular composition with a large quiet field and minimal identity elements.
entries.limit: Do not use a printed disc ring as a generic UI decoration or infer modern distribution from it.
entries.credit: PSX Data Center; scanner not identified

entries.title: Manual contents
entries.use: Diagrammatic lines, title hierarchy and pale paper establish the manual's technical voice.
entries.limit: PDF page 4; printed page 1. Scanned paper tint is variable, not a measured production color.

entries.title: Manual controls
entries.use: Use leader lines and direct control labels to make a compact diagram readable.
entries.limit: PDF page 6; printed page 3. Historical controller instructions are not a current PC binding map.

entries.title: Manual arsenal
entries.use: An excellent reference for a specimen column, light technical grid and adjacent practical description.
entries.limit: PDF page 21; printed page 18. The reproduced scan remains historical material, not new game documentation.

entries.title: Manual enemy register
entries.use: Compare creature silhouettes at a common visual size with short role and behavior annotations.
entries.limit: PDF page 28; printed page 25. Scale is editorial, not a common world-unit measurement.

entries.title: US campaign first page
entries.use: The orange campaign field, machinery frame and angular technical copy establish the warm secondary direction for new project artwork.
entries.limit: Cross-promotes PlayStation and Nintendo 64. Its companion page is retained in the archive, not used as PSX render evidence.

entries.title: UK campaign advert
entries.use: One photographic metaphor, a large stamp and an inset screenshot strip create a strong reading order.
entries.limit: The violet and meat-red photographic campaign remains a historical reference. Its palette does not prescribe colors for evidence captures.

entries.title: BASE0 entry passage
entries.use: Rock planes, muted warm material and a narrow route establish a compact directional composition.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 510, 4:3. Stationary view; no movement or hardware-equivalence claim.

entries.title: BASE3 industrial corridor
entries.use: Repetition, rust color and a receding corridor produce the industrial rhythm.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 510. This is the current port, with CRT and bloom disabled.

entries.title: SECURITY blue machinery
entries.use: Cold blue equipment, symmetrical stairs and a dark middle field separate structure from luminous detail.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 60. Lighting is scene-specific; do not apply the blue tint indiscriminately.

entries.title: WASTE1 rock and green light
entries.use: A warm rock envelope meets a localized green source. The opening provides the main focal shape.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 60. The view weapon and HUD belong to the actual capture.

entries.title: Front-end selection
entries.use: The large emblem, quiet black field and narrow blue band establish an economical hierarchy.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 60. The host input prompt is current project behavior.

entries.title: Mission panel
entries.use: A luminous metal bracket separates a compact mission message from the scene behind it.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 60, --objectives 1. The panel is intentionally visible.

entries.title: Frontend bitmap sheet
entries.use: Inspect the menu letterforms, small symbols, prompts and frame components as source pixels.
entries.limit: Inspector VRAM view using its text palette. Individual glyph draw palettes can differ; this is not a scalable font.

entries.title: HUD text and icon specimen
entries.use: Inspect runtime font colors, message vocabulary and fixed-pixel spacing in the inspector's overlay specimen.
entries.limit: Offline HUD test composition. It is not a captured gameplay event or a new menu layout.

entries.title: Soldier model study
entries.use: The front view makes the helmet, armor mass, exposed arms and held weapon legible without a scene behind them.
entries.limit: Offline BASE0 model render; clip 0, frame 0, yaw 2048. Inspector view and lighting. Recorded crop; not original hardware evidence.

entries.title: Blaster model study
entries.use: Inspect the muzzle, compact receiver and first-person mesh construction. Do not infer a separate world pickup from this view-model asset.
entries.limit: Offline BASE0 Blaster G render; clip 0, frame 0, yaw 256. This is a view-model asset. Framed with a recorded crop.

entries.title: Armor plane
entries.use: Broad olive-gray planes, a restrained bevel and a few construction details carry the heavy material.
entries.limit: Cover detail crop. Preserve scale and mass; this is not a repeatable texture.

entries.title: Oxidized panel
entries.use: Directional warm corrosion breaks up a large surface while leaving the underlying plane legible.
entries.limit: Cover detail crop. Printed halftone and scan variation remain in the image.

entries.title: Weapon cylinder
entries.use: Orange cylindrical machinery, a dark housing and small metallic edges create depth with few shapes.
entries.limit: Cover detail crop. Treat the orange as material and light context, not a universal warning color.

entries.title: Blue equipment
entries.use: A concentrated blue detail field contrasts with the darker structural surround.
entries.limit: Crop of A13. Light and surface are combined in this render; it is not an albedo texture.

entries.title: Rock surface
entries.use: Irregular broad shapes and warm-to-green variation make the organic enclosure distinct from metal.
entries.limit: Crop of A14. Perspective and scene lighting are preserved; the crop is not seamless.

entries.title: Panel corner
entries.use: A compact bevel and clipped bracket turn a small source tile into a recognizable frame component.
entries.limit: 46 x 29 source-pixel crop at (32,224). Magnified without smoothing for study.

entries.title: BOSS1 focal doorway
entries.use: Dark foreground structure isolates a warm doorway and gives the composition a single deep focal point.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 60. This is an environment and status reference, not a boss model portrait.

entries.title: HUD status detail
entries.use: Health, armor and ammunition are grouped with icons. Pale outlined numerals stay readable against the darker scene.
entries.limit: Crop of A13. The values are state-dependent and are not prescribed layout constants.

entries.title: THEVAT blue chamber
entries.use: Cobalt-lit walls and deep blue recesses establish a cool environment across most of the image. Useful for the primary brand atmosphere.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 180, default spawn. No tint or optional bloom applied.

entries.title: MATRIX5 violet sky
entries.use: The violet sky and purple-blue upper light coexist with warm rock and orange illumination. Keep both temperature families legible.
entries.limit: PAL client display capture, frame 180, default spawn. A location study, not a claim that every level shares this palette.

entries.title: BASE1 source-linked flare
entries.use: A bright lamp anchors the glow and narrow burst. Low-contrast ghost elements extend toward and beyond the frame center.
entries.limit: PAL client, frame 60; recorded position and yaw 256. Native flare with CRT and bloom off.

entries.title: Native flare detail
entries.use: The bright core, tapered rays and faint polygonal ghosting remain attached to a visible source. Compare the dark space around the effect.
entries.limit: Crop of A31, without recoloring or added glow. The exact element behavior is documented in FORMATS section 17.3.
